messages:
olivia: quick async standup — onboarding + evals update

olivia: yesterday: pushed quantized weights (int8) for llama3-smallq to staging; added prompt set onboarding-v2 with 120 cases; ran smoke evals. saw a spike in reranker false positives on chat-case #43.
olivia: blocker: reranker precision drop ~8% vs baseline on long-context prompts. can't ship canary until this is understood.

marc: looking into reranker logs now, can you paste the failing trace or sample prompt? :eyes: @olivia

olivia: paste below — it's from the failing eval run: `reranker_score=0.12, expected>0.6` for prompt id `onboard-43` (context ~3k tokens)

priya: fwiw we saw similar drop when KV cache chunking changed in runtime v2.3.0 — could be a cache eviction / prefix alignment thing. pinging eng-runtime.

rui: quick check: did you use the new attention mask optimization? that changed some positional handling in tails.

olivia: yes used opt-attn=true in the compile profile. I can re-run with opt-attn=false to compare. will do now.

eval-bot: automated results for run 1895007777-olivia-smoke: overall pass rate 92/120, reranker precision on long-context 0.58 (-0.08 vs baseline). Full logs: https://redwood.internal/evals/1895007777

marc: thanks — can you also run the batch with `--kv-chunk-size=512`? if it's a chunking vs attention mismatch we'll see the diff.

olivia: running both: config A = opt-attn=true, kv-chunk=1024 (current); config B = opt-attn=false, kv-chunk=512. will post quick diff when done.

priya: if config B fixes it, we should gate canary on reverting opt-attn for this model or applying a compatibility shim in runtime. I'll draft a short rollback playbook in the runbook doc: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/onboard-checklist#reranker-gating

rui: also flagging that embedding job for prompt set indexing ran out of memory last night; I boosted instance, requeued. could impact eval throughput ~1h delay.

olivia: noted. ETA for my diff: ~18m. I'll update thread when both runs finish. if marc/priya confirm, I'll block the canary until we have a fix or explicit mitigation.

marc: ack. thanks — will grab logs now and triage priorities. if you want a quick pairing session, I have a 30m slot after lunch.

olivia: sounds good — pairing would speed root cause. thanks everyone :thumbsup:

(edited)
